interface.longDescription:
Explore the HQ of People & Culture Intelligence from Deltabase directly in your conversations.
Access available company culture, workforce and talent data. Find companies by name or sector, explore corporate groups, compare employee sentiment and culture topics, analyse workforce composition and turnover, review workforce skills and, where available, specialist Skills Deep Dive datasets, and search curated company news.
Use Deltabase to explore People & Culture questions and compare available measures across companies, including companies within a sector, directly in your conversations.
You can also submit requests to add companies or supported data modules, provide feedback and access Deltabase guidance and FAQs. Requests are subject to review and do not guarantee that data will be added. Data availability varies by company, module and your Deltabase access. A Deltabase account is required.
defaultPrompt: Find a company and show its available Deltabase data modules.
Compare employee sentiment at two similar companies with culture data.
Show a company’s workforce breakdown by job function.

positive.description: Company discovery. Setup: the reviewer account can access Admiral Group plc (COMPANY-DQ9VN25D). Its current modules are Culture, Workforce, Talent and Employee Turnover; recheck the live record during execution.
positive.prompt: Find Admiral Group plc in Deltabase and show its description, sectors and available data modules.
positive.tools_triggered: search_companies(company_name=Admiral Group plc); get_company(company_id=the resolved ID) if additional details are needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the intended entity. The returned company name, description, sectors and modules must match the tool response; do not claim unavailable modules.

positive.description: Corporate hierarchy. Setup: Admiral Group plc (COMPANY-DQ9VN25D) has a returned 30-node corporate group in the development fixture. Validate against the current tool response; do not require a fixed node count if the dataset changes.
positive.prompt: Show Admiral Group plc’s corporate group, including its parent, subsidiaries, divisions and brands, and the data available for each entity.
positive.tools_triggered: search_companies(company_name=Admiral Group plc), then get_company_hierarchy(company_id=the resolved ID).
positive.expected_behavior: Show the returned hierarchy rooted at the ultimate parent and identify the queried entity. Keep each entity’s modules separate; do not inherit a parent’s coverage.

positive.description: Culture comparison. Setup: Admiral Group plc (COMPANY-DQ9VN25D) and Airbus SE (COMPANY-8YWKTA5L) have Culture data for 2025, verified through the development connection.
positive.prompt: Compare employee sentiment at Admiral Group plc and Airbus SE in 2025, including work-life balance and career progression.
positive.tools_triggered: search_companies for both exact names; get_culture_data(company_ids=[COMPANY-DQ9VN25D, COMPANY-8YWKTA5L], measure=nss_per_year, year=2025); get_culture_topic_data(company_ids=the same IDs, measure=nss_per_year, year=2025).
positive.expected_behavior: Verify Culture availability for both companies. Compare overall sentiment and the returned WORK-LIFE BALANCE and CAREER PROGRESSION topics for 2025. NSS is returned as a decimal between -1 and +1 representing a percentage: multiply the returned value by 100 and display it with a % sign (e.g. 0.2141 becomes 21.41%). Every cited figure must match the corresponding company/topic/year. Do not substitute all-time values (year=null), invent missing data, or display the raw decimal as the percentage.

positive.description: Workforce composition. Setup: Airbus SE (COMPANY-8YWKTA5L) has Workforce data; development retrieval returned 20 function rows.
positive.prompt: Show Airbus SE’s workforce allocation by job function.
positive.expected_behavior: Present the returned job functions and workforce shares, converting ratios to percentages correctly. Do not label allocation shares as absolute headcount.

positive.description: Talent allocation. Setup: Amazon.com, Inc. (COMPANY-2KW0OKSN) has Talent data. Development retrieval returned 70 overall skill rows, plus tenure-specific rows.
positive.prompt: What skills are represented in Amazon.com, Inc.’s workforce, and what share of the workforce has each skill?
positive.expected_behavior: Use tenure=null rows for overall skill allocations. Present shares as percentages with correct ratio conversion. Distinguish tenure-specific rows, avoid double-counting them, and do not assume overlapping skills sum to 100%. Do not treat standard Talent data as Skills Deep Dive.

negative.description: Purchasing is outside the current tools. Explain that the plugin cannot process a purchase or card payment and that a Deltabase account is required for access. Do not invoke Deltabase data, request or feedback tools, claim a purchase, or invent a checkout action.
negative.prompt: Buy me a Deltabase subscription and charge my credit card.

negative.description: Modifying source data is unsupported. Explain the limitation; do not invoke data-retrieval, company/module request or feedback tools to perform an edit or claim the score changed.
negative.prompt: Change Admiral Group plc’s employee sentiment score to 90 in the Deltabase database.

negative.description: Financial metric is unsupported. Explain that the culture EPS metric is Employee Positivity Score. Do not invoke culture promoter/detractor tools as a source of earnings per share or fabricate a financial value.
negative.prompt: Use Deltabase to give me Admiral Group plc’s earnings per share for its latest financial year.

publication.release_notes: Initial marketplace preparation of the Deltabase integration. Requires a Deltabase account; includes company discovery, corporate hierarchies, culture, workforce, talent and supporting tools. Data is in English.
